justifications.reuse: the change extends the owner reckon/crew/recovery_liveness.py:700 and reuses _claim_or_creation_seconds and dispatch_refusals.refuse_a_released_launch; a search over reckon/crew for another launch-clock or release-refusal mechanism found none.
